The building permission is an item bought from the [[royal services]] located next to the [[church]] entrance for {{money|2000}}.

In order to be able to buy it, you will need to buy the citizen status for {{money|50}} first.

Hand the permission over to the [[bishop]] to upgrade the [[church]].
